_comment: reforgeCompare's store-table registry (lane REFORGE, forgeClean R3, 2026-10-08). One row per table a build's stores may hold. identityColumnNameList names a row for the report (it pairs an A row with its B twin); digestColumnNameList are large columns compared by sha256 rather than carried; contentAddressColumnName, when present, names the column that MUST equal sha256 of the first digest column (the store's own content-address rule, re-verified on both sides). A table found in a store and absent here is REFUSED by name: a table nobody registered is a table nobody compared.
